propositions: A 0-byte enrich-drain.lock file with no owner stamp can be leaked permanently when a drain process dies between lock creation and release, causing all subsequent drain attempts to fail silently with FileExistsError and skip enrichment indefinitely

The lock file must be stamped with an owner identifier on acquisition and evaluated for staleness on collision, reusing the existing lock_owner._stamp_is_stale core decision logic with unrecognised_via_ceiling=True to treat unstamped orphans as reclaimable after the wall-clock ceiling threshold

A stale drain lock must be reclaimed with exactly one bounded retry: log at WARNING with holder stamp and age, unlink, retry create once, and return None if collision occurs again, preventing permanent wedging while respecting live holders
The drain skip log must move from INFO to WARNING and name the holder to make silent wedges visible without requiring doctor diagnostics to detect a stuck enrichment pipeline
Doctor's drain lock report must decode the stamp and provide a real staleness verdict instead of not-assessable, treating unstamped or dead-holder locks as stale-lock findings at exit 1
